# 1.1 Reject configuration keys with the wrong case

## What landed

- `config: reject keys with the wrong case` — `config.Load` now validates every
  top-level key from `toml.MetaData.Keys()` against the exact spellings `dir`,
  `kinds`, `areas`, instead of relying on `Undecoded`, which misses keys the
  decoder matched case-insensitively. Rejected keys are quoted in the error.
- `TestLoadRejectsCaseVariantKeys` covers `Kinds`, `Dir`, `AREAS`, an unrelated
  `foo`, and acceptance of all three lowercase keys with their values.

## Landmark drift

None. `internal/config/config.go` and `config_test.go` are where the work order
said.

## Deviations from the work order

None. The unknown-key error keeps its existing wording and now names every
rejected key, comma-separated.

## What the next session must know

- `meta.Keys()` includes key groups, so a nested key fails the `len(key) != 1`
  check and its dotted `key.String()` is reported. `Undecoded` is no longer
  used.
- `DESIGN.md` already promises an unknown key is an error and lists the three
  lowercase keys, so no design change was needed.
- Both `scripts/verify` and `go test ./...` were green before the commit.

## Open problems

None.
